title: How to choose a web host: is Hostinger worth it for your site?
seoTitle: Choosing a web host: Hostinger prices and renewal, October 2026
description: How to choose a web host by renewal, cycle, server location and VPS. Hostinger's international prices in US dollars on October 30, 2026, with renewal.
metaDescription: How to choose a web host: renewal, the 48-month cycle, server location and VPS. Hostinger's international prices in US dollars on October 30, 2026, with the renewal next to each one.

contentSections.heading: Quick answer
paragraphs: By renewal price, Hostinger's Premium is the cheapest plan, and Unlimited is the one for many sites, with no site limit. Start with your application's requirements, not just site count. SONAR20 gives 20% off a new Hostinger purchase, not a renewal.

contentSections.heading: The four criteria that decide
paragraphs: Every host sells its first period with a steep discount, and that is where comparisons go wrong. What weighs on the budget is the month after the promotion. Before the prices, these are the four criteria we use to compare:

image.alt: Chart with four criteria for choosing hosting: renewal, the monthly price after the first period; cycle, how many months the promotion lasts; server in the country, if the page says where the server is; and VPS, if you need guaranteed resources
image.caption: The four criteria: renewal, cycle, server in the country and VPS. Chart by Em Casa com Cecília.

bullets: **Renewal.** Hostinger shows each plan's renewal price on the card. Read it before the promotional price.
**Cycle.** Hostinger's promotional price applies to the 48-month plan. The total of one term does not compare with the total of another. Per month, it does.
**Server in the country.** Hostinger has data centers in Europe, Asia, North America and South America. The list depends on the plan and on availability, so check it when you sign up.
**VPS.** If the site needs guaranteed processor and memory, the comparison is different, further down.

contentSections.heading: Hostinger prices
paragraphs: On Hostinger, the promotion lasts 48 months and renewal costs 3 to 5 times the promotional price. Prices on October 30, 2026, on the international site, in US dollars, during a Black Friday campaign with no end date:
postParagraphs: Prices without SONAR20. Premium has weekly backups; Unlimited, daily. Prices can vary by country and currency, so check the cart.

contentSections.heading: The plans, per month
paragraphs: The plans do not line up one to one, and the step up follows the number of sites. By number of sites, with the monthly price in the first period and after it:
bullets: **Up to 3 sites:** Premium, US$2.49 a month for 48 months, renewing at US$10.99. It is the cheapest in the promotion and at renewal.

**Many sites:** Unlimited, US$3.49 a month, renewing at US$16.99. It has no site limit on the page and 50 GB of NVMe, against 20 GB of SSD on Premium. The gap to Premium is US$1 a month in the promotion and US$6 at renewal.

**The top plan:** Cloud Startup renews at US$25.99 a month and costs more than twice as much as Unlimited in the promotion. It only pays off if you need what it adds, such as 100 GB of NVMe; for many ordinary sites, Unlimited does the job for less.
contentSections.emphasis: The total of the first cycle is misleading: compare the monthly price, with the renewal next to it.

contentSections.heading: What the price does not show
bullets: **Storage.** The entry plan, Premium, has 20 GB of SSD. NVMe, at 50 GB, starts on Unlimited.
**Backup.** Premium has weekly backups; Unlimited, daily. Before you choose, check that the backup you need is in the plan you want.
**Server location.** Data centers run from Europe to South America, depending on the plan and availability. Check the list when you sign up.
**Renewal in the cart.** Before you pay, read the renewal price in the cart, not only the promotional monthly price.
**Refunds.** Read the refund policy before you buy. How Hostinger charges, renews and refunds is covered in [Is Hostinger legit?](/en/reviews/is-hostinger-legit).

contentSections.heading: What if it's a VPS?
paragraphs: If you are not yet sure whether you need a VPS or shared hosting, start with [VPS or shared hosting: which one pays off for your site on Hostinger](/en/reviews/vps-or-shared-hosting-which-to-choose). For those who have already chosen a VPS, these are the entry plans on the international site, in US dollars:
postParagraphs: The VPS renewal is almost double the promotional price: KVM 1 goes from US$6.49 to US$11.99 a month, and KVM 2 from US$8.79 to US$14.99. These are the 24-month promotion prices. SONAR20 works on the VPS, so check the price in the cart before you buy.

contentSections.heading: SONAR20 on Hostinger
paragraphs: Enter **SONAR20** in the cart for 20% off the first term of an eligible new purchase, including with an existing account. It works on e-commerce Startup, professional email and Reach. For the hosting or VPS plan you choose, check its application in the cart. Domain registration and renewal are excluded. See [Hostinger coupons](/en/coupons/hostinger).

contentSections.heading: Which to choose: the verdict
paragraphs: **Choose Premium** for one site, such as a blog, a portfolio or a company page, or for up to three sites, if storage and backup meet your needs: it costs less in the promotion and at renewal, and the promotion lasts 48 months.
**Choose Unlimited** for many sites, with no site limit, daily backups and 50 GB of NVMe. Cloud Startup, which renews at more than US$25 a month, only pays off if you need the extra storage.
**In both cases**, read the renewal column before you pay and confirm the amount in the cart. Hostinger is running a campaign, and prices can change.
If it were for my site, I would take Premium for one site, because it costs less in the promotion and at renewal.

contentSections.heading: Frequently asked questions
bullets: Which web host is better? It depends on what the application needs, on storage and backup, and on whether the promotion or the renewal matters more to you. Site count alone does not decide it.
Which Hostinger plan renews for the least? Premium, at US$10.99 a month on the international site, after a 48-month promotion at US$2.49.
Is a Hostinger VPS worth it? It depends on the load the site puts on it. Compare vCPU, memory and renewal: KVM 1 renews at US$11.99 a month on the international site.

Does Hostinger say where its servers are? Yes. Its official list names data centers in Europe, Asia, North America and South America for web, cloud and VPS plans, subject to availability. Email is stored separately, in France and Germany.
Does SONAR20 work on a Hostinger VPS? Yes, on an eligible new VPS purchase: 20% off the first term. Check your plan's discount in the cart.
Can you switch hosts without losing the site? Yes, by moving the files and the database to the new host. Do the move before the old plan expires.

Does SONAR20 work for people who are already Hostinger customers? Yes, on an eligible new purchase with the same account. The renewal of a plan you already have is charged at the list price, with no discount.

contentSections.heading: Who writes this
paragraphs: Em Casa com Cecília runs on Hostinger's managed hosting, and the domain has been registered with Hostinger since 2024. This text gathers what Hostinger's international pages say.

takeIf: Take Premium if it is one site, such as a blog, a portfolio or a company page, or up to three, and its storage and backup meet your needs: it costs less in the promotion and at renewal.
Take a VPS if the site needs guaranteed processor and memory: KVM 1 already has 4 GB.
skipIf: Skip Premium if you will have more than three sites: Unlimited has no site limit.
Skip Premium if storage and daily backups matter to you: it has 20 GB of SSD and weekly backups.
